about_hero_subtitle: Cultivating the future of organic pitahaya with roots of tradition and excellence.
about_origins_p1: More than six years ago, a group of farmers from Cañete began to grow pitahaya independently. Without documentation, without formality, but with a clear idea: to produce quality fruit to support their families.
about_origins_p2: Thus, the Tuta Wayta Pitahaya Producers Association was born. Kelly Carvajal took over the presidency, Talía Rodríguez the vice-presidency, and together they opened the doors for institutions like Agromercado to support us.

history_hero_p: From independent farmers to a formal association. Each year tells a story of perseverance, community, and dreams coming true in the Cañete valley.
history_origins_title1: An idea was born in the
history_origins_p1: More than six years ago, in the Cañete valley, a group of farmers began to grow pitahaya independently. Without papers, without formality, without fair prices. Only fertile land, coastal sun, and the conviction that this exotic fruit could change their lives.
history_origins_p2: For years they sold to intermediaries who dictated low prices. The lack of documentation left them out of state support. They were simple farmers, invisible to the system.
history_origins_p3: Everything changed when Kelly Carvajal and Talia Rodríguez Rojas decided to formalize. Under a carob tree, amidst neighborly conversations, a question arose: why not unite?
history_quote_text: We were simple farmers. We had no papers, no fair prices, no voice. The day we formalized, we regained our dignity and our future.
history_timeline_p: Each year tells a story of perseverance, learning, and collective growth in the Cañete valley, strengthening our roots, community work, and commitment to a sustainable future.
history_t1_p: Carlos Quispe and 5 farming families from Cañete Alto decide to unite to jointly market their pitahaya, tired of the abusive prices of intermediaries.
history_t2_p: The association is formalized before the municipality of San Vicente de Cañete with 12 founding members. 'Tuta Wayta' means 'flower of the night' in Quechua, in honor of the pitahaya flowers.
history_t3_p: We obtain the group organic certification from SENASA, a milestone that opens doors to formal markets. Sales increase by 65% in the first year.
history_t4_p: The association grows to 25 producer members and a support fund is created for climate emergencies.
history_t5_p: An artisanal plant is inaugurated to produce jams, nectars, and dehydrated pulp.
history_t6_p: Alliances are established with restaurants and health food stores in Metropolitan Lima.
history_t7_p: Today we are more than 30 producer families, with sustainable production and international projection.
history_testimonials_p: The real voices of those who built Tuta Wayta from the ground up, with their hands and their hearts.
history_test1_p: "I used to sell my harvest for whatever they offered. Today, I decide the price. That changed my life and my children's lives."
history_test2_p: "Unity gave us strength. Alone, I achieved nothing. With my 29 partners, today we are masters of our own destiny."
history_test3_p: "When SENASA arrived, I felt proud. It meant our work was serious, clean, and worthy of respect."
history_test4_p: "My son is studying agronomy because he saw that farming can be an honest business. That is the legacy of Tuta Wayta."
history_test5_p: "Women have a voice here. We are not farmers' wives: we are farmers, leaders, and decision-makers."
history_test6_p: "Tuta Wayta is not just a company, it's our family. Together we show that the Cañete valley has infinite potential."
history_founders_p: Kelly and Talía didn't just found an association. They lit a flame that today illuminates 30 producer families.

benefits_ideas_p: You don't have to be a chef. Here are 4 simple and delicious ways to consume pitahaya every day.
benefits_idea1_p: 1/2 pitahaya, banana, almond milk, and chia. Ideal for breakfast.
benefits_idea2_p: Diced pitahaya with mango, avocado, and lemon dressing. Fresh and nutritious.
benefits_idea3_p: Chopped pitahaya over Greek yogurt with granola and honey. Perfect snack.

benefits_expert1_q: "I recommend Tuta Wayta's pitahaya to my athlete patients. The hydration and antioxidant supply are superior to other brands I've tried."
benefits_expert2_q: "The yellow variety from Tuta Wayta has a noticeable digestive effect. I regularly prescribe it to patients with slow transit issues."
benefits_expert3_q: "Since I included American Beauty pitahaya in my diet, my digestion has improved remarkably. And the taste is incredibly sweet."
benefits_faq1_q: How much pitahaya should I consume per day?
benefits_faq1_a: It is recommended to consume between 100g and 200g daily (approximately half to one medium pitahaya). This amount provides an excellent supply of fiber, vitamins, and antioxidants without exceeding natural sugar intake.
benefits_faq2_a: Yes. Pitahaya has a low glycemic index (GI 48) and its fiber slows down sugar absorption. However, we always recommend consulting with a medical nutritionist to personalize the portion for each case.
benefits_faq3_q: Can I eat it on an empty stomach?
benefits_faq3_a: Absolutely. Consuming pitahaya on an empty stomach enhances its digestive effect and allows for better absorption of its nutrients. The yellow variety is especially recommended for this purpose.
benefits_faq4_q: Which is the best variety for weight loss?
benefits_faq4_a: The White Flesh variety is the most recommended due to its low calorie content (57 kcal/100g) and high water percentage. It keeps you full without providing fats or refined sugars.
benefits_faq5_q: How long does fresh pitahaya last?
benefits_faq5_a: In the refrigerator, fresh ripe pitahaya lasts between 5 and 7 days. If it is very ripe at the time of purchase, consume it within 2-3 days. Processed products (yogurt, nectar, jam) have a longer shelf life.

services_hero_p: Discover how Tuta Wayta can help you with our specialized services in organic pitahaya.
services_grid_p: From fresh fruit to the development of innovative products, our services are designed to bring the quality of Tuta Wayta to your business and community.
services_card1_p: We provide high-quality organic pitahaya to restaurants, markets, and distributors, guaranteeing freshness and traceability.
services_card2_p: We collaborate with brands to create innovative products such as jams, nectars, and pulps, using our pitahaya as the main ingredient.
services_card3_p: We offer training and technical advice on organic pitahaya cultivation for farmers and associations.
services_card4_p: We organize guided tours of our plantations in Cañete so you can see the cultivation and harvesting process up close.
services_eco_p: From planting to export, each service is designed to deliver the best Peruvian pitahaya.
services_p1_p: From preparing soils with natural compost to planting pitahaya seedlings, we cultivate every hectare with deep respect for the land.
services_p2_p: Each fruit is harvested by hand at the exact moment of ripeness, ensuring maximum sweetness and quality.
services_p3_p: We transform fresh pitahaya into high-value products, preserving its essential nutrients and vibrant color.
services_p4_eyebrow: From the field to your market
services_p4_p: We connect direct producers with local markets, prestigious restaurants, and large commercial chains.
services_p5_p: We offer practical workshops and highly specialized advice to optimize yield per hectare.
services_p6_p: We comply with the most demanding international phytosanitary regulations to cross borders safely.
services_m1_s1_p: We evaluate the soil microbiota and incorporate high-quality bio-organized fertilizers to deeply nourish the roots from day one.
services_m1_s2_p: We assemble firm structures that will support the heavy branches of the cactus, maximizing sun capture and proper air flow for the plants.
services_m1_s3_p: We apply automated micro-drip systems to deliver the exact amount of water to the root zones, protecting this vital resource without waste.
services_m1_s4_p: We implement completely natural biological solutions and botanical repellents, discarding the use of harmful agrochemicals.
services_m2_s1_p: Our harvesters identify the ideal ripeness through visual indicators: uniform intense fuchsia color, slightly elastic texture, and characteristic aroma.
services_m2_s2_p: We use sterilized pruning shears to cut the stem without damaging the peel. Each fruit is handled individually to avoid bruising.
services_m2_s3_p: In the field, we classify by size (weight), visual quality, and firmness. Only 75% of the production meets the export standard.
services_m2_s4_p: Within 2 hours post-harvest, the fruit is transported to pre-cooling chambers at 8°C to slow down ripening and preserve its shelf life.
services_m3_s1_p: We extract the dragon fruit pulp by strictly controlling low temperatures to keep all its antioxidants and natural fiber intact.
services_m3_s2_p: We process purified nectars, naturally sweetened jams, and premium fruit bases for fine yogurts without any artificial additives.
services_m3_s3_p: We apply an ultra-fast, safe heat treatment that eliminates harmful bacteria without altering the characteristic fuchsia color or natural flavor.
services_m3_s4_p: We seal derivatives in high thermal resistance bottles and jars that extend shelf life without the need for artificial additives.
services_m4_s1_p: We gather selected fruits into uniform categories within our central warehouse to fulfill large orders efficiently.
services_m4_s2_p: We provide priority supply to hotels, fine dining restaurants, and cafes that value fresh ingredients with local identity.
services_m4_s3_p: We place fresh dragon fruit on the shelves of the country's most important retail chains under strict on-time delivery guidelines.
services_m4_s4_p: We develop strategic activations at fairs and digital platforms to promote the multiple health benefits of this super-fruit.
services_m5_s1_p: We hold live classes directly on the field, teaching advanced agricultural management methods to small and medium-sized farmers.
services_m5_s2_p: We train personnel in training, maintenance, and production cuts to ensure the steady sprouting of healthy flowers.
services_m5_s3_p: We guide associated grower groups step-by-step to obtain Global GAP and organic seals mandatory for foreign markets.
services_m5_s4_p: We provide accounting and commercial tools so farmers can accurately calculate their production costs and actual profitability.
services_m6_s1_p: We subject all batches to exhaustive official controls that rule out the presence of quarantine pests, ensuring clean fruit.
services_m6_s2_p: We package the dragon fruit in self-assembling corrugated cardboard boxes with individual ventilated grids to cushion travel impacts.
services_m6_s3_p: We manage documentation of origin, customs permits, and shipping certificates, streamlining the passage through international ports.
services_m6_s4_p: We use controlled-atmosphere containers equipped with real-time GPS thermal sensors until delivery to the overseas client.
services_pro1_p: We design and structure complete pitahaya cultivation projects, defining the crop configuration, planting density, production system, and infrastructure needs.
services_pro1_b_p: Each project is adapted to the unique characteristics of the farm and the investor's financial return objectives, ensuring maximum efficiency from the initial planting.
services_pro2_p: We install agricultural infrastructures adapted to the environmental conditions, including greenhouses, crop support systems, and irrigation and fertigation solutions.
services_pro2_b_p: We work with different levels of technification, from essential structures to the most advanced automated systems depending on the project's scope.
services_m_inv_s1_p: Greenhouses built with high mechanical resistance materials and plastic covers with UV protection that diffuse light evenly to prevent burns on the cactus.
services_m_inv_s2_p: Integrated systems that dose liquid nutrients and water with surgical precision directly to the roots, drastically reducing water consumption.
services_m_inv_s3_p: Optimized posts and support lines to withstand heavy production loads, facilitating pruning tasks and accelerating clean manual harvesting.
services_nursery_p1: We cultivate pitahaya using 100% ecological methods, providing the best conditions and care to produce a fruit of excellent quality and flavor.
services_nursery_p2: We supply selected plant material, with technical control and a phytosanitary passport, guaranteeing traceability and crop health from its establishment. Our production is aimed at offering homogeneous plants adapted to the conditions of each project.
services_m_nur1_p: We guarantee management focused on comprehensive organic nutrition and the balance of the agricultural ecosystem, maximizing the yield of each plant.
services_m_nur1_s1_p: We use biofertilizers and mature compost rich in beneficial microorganisms to stimulate a strong and resistant root system.
services_m_nur1_s2_p: We implement continuous technical inspections to prevent pests naturally, avoiding the use of harmful synthetic chemicals.
services_m_nur2_p: We transform fresh pitahaya into high-value products: nectar, jam, dehydrated pulp, and yogurt.
services_m_nur2_s1_p: We receive second and third-grade fruit—perfectly edible but not suitable for fresh export—thus avoiding food waste.
services_m_nur2_s2_p: All processes are carried out between 4°C and 15°C to preserve vitamins, antioxidants, and the vibrant natural color of the pitahaya.
services_m_nur2_s3_p: We press the pulp and filter it without adding water or sugar. The nectar is pasteurized at 85°C for 30 seconds and packaged under aseptic conditions.
services_m_nur2_s4_p: We cook the pulp with 35% organic cane sugar and natural lemon juice. The process takes 45 minutes in stainless steel pots.

blog_cta_description: Every dragon fruit you buy supports more than 30 farming families. Each order strengthens a rural community that chose formality, quality, and sustainable development in the Cañete valley.
about_hero_subtitle: Cultivating the future of organic dragon fruit with roots of tradition and excellence.
about_origins_p1: More than six years ago, a group of farmers from Cañete began growing dragon fruit independently. Without documentation or formality, but with a clear idea: to produce quality fruit to support their families.
about_origins_p2: Thus, the Tuta Wayta Dragon Fruit Producers Association was born. Kelly Carvajal took over the presidency, Talía Rodríguez the vice-presidency, and together they opened the doors for institutions like Agromercado to support us.
about_pillar1_desc: We were born as an association of producers committed to restoring value to the land. Today, we consolidate a production chain focused on quality, traceability, and access to national and international markets.
about_pillar2_desc: To produce and market organic dragon fruit under technical and sustainable standards, guaranteeing safety, export quality, and economic development for our partners.
about_pillar3_desc: To position ourselves as a benchmark for premium Peruvian dragon fruit, standing out for certifications, agricultural innovation, and recognition in international markets.
about_values_subtitle: Principles that represent our identity and commitment to quality, the environment, and sustainable development.
about_value1_desc: Absolute commitment to the life cycle of the environment, regenerating the soil for future generations.
about_value2_desc: The collective strength of our producers allows us to bring the best fruit in the world to your table.
about_value3_desc: We pursue technical excellence in every single fruit, from its size to its Brix degree level.
about_value4_desc: Pure natural cultivation, free of synthetic chemicals, respecting the biodiversity of the ecosystem.
about_value5_desc: Real equity between associated men and women, guaranteeing a voice and a vote in all spheres.
about_value6_desc: Sustainable development and constant expansion to ensure the prosperity of our families.
about_certs_subtitle: Our formalization and the quality of our processes have opened doors for us with national institutions.
about_cert1_desc: Sanitary recognition for organic production and crop traceability in Cañete.
about_cert2_desc: Institutional support in formalization, training, and access to formal markets.
about_cert3_desc: In the process of obtaining formal organic certification for future export.
about_cert4_desc: Association formally registered with SUNAT with an active RUC for commercial operations.
about_cycle_subtitle: Learn about the complete production process of our dragon fruit, from the plant to your table.
about_cycle1_desc: We select fertile lands in Cañete and prepare the soil with natural organic compost, without synthetic fertilizers.
about_cycle2_desc: Dragon fruit plants grow supported on wooden posts, under the coastal sun and with controlled irrigation.
about_cycle3_desc: Dragon fruit blooms at night. Its spectacular white flowers last only one night before turning into fruit.
about_cycle4_desc: We harvest by hand when the fruit reaches its optimum point of ripeness, guaranteeing flavor and freshness.
about_cycle5_desc: Each fruit goes through a visual and weight control. Only the best reach the market and our derived products.
about_team_subtitle: Leading the transformation and organic quality from the field to the final customer.
team_page_p: More than 30 producer partners make up the Tuta Wayta family. Meet those who lead our association.
team_m1_bio: Visionary leader who has guided Tuta Wayta from its informal beginnings to its formalization as an association.
team_m2_bio: A pitahaya producer for over six years, she combines her field experience with a commercial vision.
team_m3_bio: Experienced farmer who contributes his practical knowledge and critical vision to improve processes.
team_m4_bio: With deep knowledge of the production cycle, Henry coordinates harvest planning.
team_m5_bio: Responsible for strengthening the bonds between partners and the Cañete community.
team_m6_bio: Seeking new growth opportunities for the association and international markets.
team_assoc_p: Each image tells the story of nature in its purest form. Our pitahayas grow with dedication, sun, and passion to reach you fresh.
team_assoc_extra_p: More than 30 producer partners from the valley work in coordination under the central board, ensuring optimal technical management and the best export quality of our pitahayas to your table.
team_more_p: The strength of Tuta Wayta lies not only in its board but in each of the farmers who care for the plants, harvest the fruit, and make the growth of this association possible day by day.
team_cta_title: Want to be part of Tuta Wayta?
team_cta_p: We are constantly looking for new talent and producer partners committed to organic farming and sustainable development. If you share our vision, we would love to meet you.

team_modal_vicepresidenta_desc: Producer with a long trajectory in the field who is responsible for balancing the technical requirements of farming with the commercial positioning of the fruit in the domestic market.
team_modal_vicepresidenta_p1: More than 6 years of direct experience in the specialized cultivation of dragon fruit varieties.
team_modal_vicepresidenta_p2: Design and development of logistical channels for direct distribution without intermediaries.
team_modal_vicepresidenta_p3: Coordinator of the association's participation in international fairs and business roundtables.
team_modal_vicepresidenta_p4: Supervisor of preventive quality control during the post-harvest process.
team_modal_tesorero_desc: In charge of ensuring the financial health of the association, executing internal audits, and managing budgets transparently and efficiently for the collective benefit.
team_modal_tesorero_p1: Optimization of the annual budget for the corporate purchase of organic inputs.
team_modal_tesorero_p2: Clear management and accountability in each assembly through financial reports.
team_modal_tesorero_p3: Evaluation of return on investment (ROI) for the implementation of irrigation technologies.
team_modal_tesorero_p4: Management of the common fund destined for agricultural or climatic emergencies of the members.
team_modal_produccion_desc: Technical lead responsible for standardizing cultivation processes across all members' plots, ensuring that the fruit meets the sizing and quality required for export.
team_modal_produccion_p1: Design and implementation of unified calendars for 100% organic fertilization.
team_modal_produccion_p2: Scheduling and zoning of staggered harvests to maintain a constant supply flow.
team_modal_produccion_p3: Direction of technical field training on pruning, guiding, and crop management.
team_modal_produccion_p4: Specialist in preventive biological control of pests native to the valley.
team_modal_comunidad_desc: Responsible for strengthening the association's social fabric, promoting fair trade values, equity, and the well-being of all farming families in the valley.
team_modal_comunidad_p1: Organization of participatory and integration workshops for members and their families.
team_modal_comunidad_p2: Management of social welfare and sustainable development programs in the Cañete community.
team_modal_comunidad_p3: Mediation and peaceful resolution of internal conflicts within the production chain.
team_modal_comunidad_p4: Promoter of international Fair Trade regulations and standards.
team_modal_innovacion_desc: Future-focused agricultural technology leader, responsible for seeking new international quality certifications and adapting bio-friendly packaging to conquer premium markets.
team_modal_innovacion_p1: Research and adaptation of standards to obtain the Global G.A.P. certification.
team_modal_innovacion_p2: Development and testing of eco-friendly packaging that extends the shelf life of the fruit.
team_modal_innovacion_p3: Analysis and monitoring of global trends in the consumption of organic superfruits.
team_modal_innovacion_p4: Liaison with universities and technological centers for innovation projects.

news_hero_subtitle: Stay up to date with the achievements, events, and impact of our community in the Cañete Valley.
news_a1_title: Tuta Wayta Obtains Prestigious Global G.A.P. Certification
news_a1_p: After a rigorous audit process, our association has been awarded Global G.A.P. certification, an international standard recognizing good agricultural practices and opening doors to new export markets in Europe and North America.
news_a2_title: Successful Health and Wellness Fair for Tuta Wayta Families
news_a2_p: In partnership with the local health center, we organized a day of free medical care, nutrition talks, and recreational activities for over 100 members of our community.
news_a3_title: New Line of 100% Biodegradable Packaging Launched
news_a3_p: Reaffirming our commitment to the planet, we have implemented compostable packaging for our entire line of fresh fruit, reducing our environmental impact.
news_a11_title: Tuta Wayta Implements AI-Powered Smart Irrigation System
news_a11_p: Driven by our push for sustainability, we have implemented an AI-assisted drip irrigation system that optimizes water usage by up to 40% based on real-time weather data.
news_a12_title: Development of New Biopesticide Based on Native Plant Extracts
news_a12_p: In collaboration with research institutes, we are developing a 100% organic biopesticide from native plant extracts, reinforcing our commitment to chemical-free agriculture.
news_a4_title: Alliance with Instituto Valle Grande for Digital Development
news_a4_p: Thanks to the support of Instituto Valle Grande, we have developed our new website, a platform to connect with our customers and show the world the quality of our dragon fruit.
news_a7_title: Tuta Wayta and SENASA: Alliance for Organic Quality
news_a7_p: Thanks to our collaboration with SENASA, we have earned health recognition for our organic production, ensuring full traceability and quality for every fruit from our fields in Cañete.
news_a8_title: Agromercado Drives the Growth of Tuta Wayta
news_a8_p: Agromercado's institutional support has been key to our formalization and training, opening doors to more competitive markets and strengthening our associative model.
news_a5_title: 50 Schoolchildren Visit Fields as Part of 'Siembra Futuro' Program
news_a5_p: Students from the local school learned about the dragon fruit growth cycle, the importance of organic farming, and participated in a symbolic harvest.
news_a6_title: Tuta Wayta Wins the National Agricultural Innovation Award 2026
news_a6_p: Our associative model and the development of value-added derived products were recognized by the Ministry of Agricultural Development and Irrigation.
news_a9_title: Tuta Wayta Named 'Association of the Year' at Agro-Produce 2026
news_a9_p: Our commitment to quality, sustainability, and community development was awarded at the region's most important agricultural fair.
news_a10_title: Composting and Regenerative Agriculture Workshop for Members
news_a10_p: Over 25 members participated in a hands-on training workshop to improve soil health and optimize organic resource usage across our plots.
blog_cta_description: Every dragon fruit you buy supports more than 30 farming families. Every order empowers a rural community that chose formalization, quality, and sustainable development in the Cañete Valley.
about_origins_p1: We are the Tuta Wayta Dragon Fruit Producers Association, a large family of more than 30 artisanal farmers dedicated to cultivating and marketing top-quality dragon fruit in the fertile Cañete valleys. Tuta Wayta pays homage to the mystical 'Night Flower'. We were born with the firm conviction to revalue the work of the Peruvian countryside, transforming our passion for agriculture into a sustainable business model.
about_mission_p: To bring the finest dragon fruit and its derived products to tables across Peru and the world, guaranteeing an authentic taste. We are committed to boosting our consumers' well-being through highly nutritious food while promoting sustainable agricultural practices and ensuring the growth of our entire association.
about_vision_p: To be recognized nationally and internationally as the leading dragon fruit producer association, standing out for technical excellence, innovation, and strengthening Cañete's agricultural identity.
